<!-- pr-reviewer: a5585a1f63cad707a22abb15af21619f41fb7f7f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `sinker-iso.cps` takes the unit from `postOptions.Units` (onOpen) exactly as `wire-iso.cps` does (line 137), and declares `programUnits = "mm inch"` like wire-iso (line 27). Nothing reads `machine.units` any more.
- Every length and feed goes through the conversion in inch mode: axis words (`fu`), the pickup offset in `{offset}`, the burn depth `{z}`, and the feed `{f}` (`ff`). The orbit radius is only refused, never written. No other numeric is emitted.
- An inch document on a machine with no `edm.codes.inch` is refused by name ("states no edm.codes.inch"). The reworked `every_missing_sinker_code_refuses_the_post_by_name` still pins that refusal, now with an inch document instead of an inch machine file; the per-role missing-code loop above it is untouched, so no refusal was lost.
- The new test pins: an inch machine file under an mm or unspecified document posts the existing mm golden byte for byte; an inch document writes G20 and every X/Y/Z/H/F word / 25.4 with the rest of each line identical, no G21, and the 15 mm pickup and 14.05 mm depth are checked in inches.
- No golden or snapshot is touched (diff is the two files only); the mm goldens are unchanged.

**Local results (trial-merged with origin/main, which was already contained, so no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_sinker_iso` | 22 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test program_units` | 7 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sinker_burn` | 14 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1382`. No process files, dependencies, build.rs or `.github` touched; no PROCESS_VERSION bump needed.
- Not exercised on a real EDM control (as the script header already says).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: a5585a1f63cad707a22abb15af21619f41fb7f7f -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$0.91 (204k tokens)

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| fix (issue-worker-high) | Opus 5.5 rate assumed | 121k | ~$0.68 |
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 82k | ~$0.23 |

Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Effort: effort:high (not escalated)
